name: FM piano ninth comping
desc: Herbie-school electric-piano comping in C dorian: Cm9 and F13 voicings syncopated around the backbeat on a VCSL FM piano, chord walk-ups every 8th cycle, echo throws opening at peak. Headnodder harmony for funk, boogie or breaks.

code.full: note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [c3,eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [f2,a2,eb3,g3] [g2,bb2,f3,a3]>").add(note(${root})).struct("[x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~] [~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~]").s("fmpiano").clip(1.2).shape(.3).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.65, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.3).delay(${echo}).delaytime(.33).delayfeedback(.25).pan(cosine.range(.44,.56).slow(12)).every(8, x=>x.add(note("<0 2 3 5>"))).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [eb3,g3,bb3,d4,f4] [f2,a2,eb3,g3] [g2,bb2,f3,a3]>").add(note(${root})).struct("[x ~ x x ~ x x ~] [~ x x ~ x x ~ x]").s("fmpiano").clip(.9).shape(.35).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.28).delay(${echo}*1.4).delaytime(.25).delayfeedback(.3).pan(cosine.range(.4,.6).slow(8)).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(4).play()
